$comment: Route-drift tripwire manifest for scripts/tri-tool-conformance/run-matrix.sh (#150). Each entry is a (method, rule-normalized path shape) pair sockguard's own access log (msg=request|request_denied|request_would_deny, field `normalized_path`) is expected to ever emit while the conformance matrix's three rows run. `*` = exactly one dynamic path segment (container/network/volume/service/exec ID or name); `**` = a run of one-or-more dynamic segments (multi-part image/distribution references). Shapes are derived directly from app/configs/portwing.yaml and app/configs/portwing-with-exec.yaml's allow rules (the union of both, since legacy-floor/current-standard run the plain preset and current-edge runs the exec preset) plus the two deliberate-denial probes assertion 9 sends (POST /build, GET /containers/*/export) so those expected denials don't themselves trip the tripwire. This file is checked in and updated deliberately in PRs -- see the harness README's 'Updating this manifest' section. ANY route observed in a live run that is not listed here fails the job: 'peer repository sent a route sockguard policy has not reviewed -- review policy, then update known-routes.json'.
